## DENTAL INFECTIONS
Surgical drainage, scaling and antimicrobial treatment are essential. All
patients should be referred to the dental service for assessment and direction
of treatment. Empirical coverage for likely pathogens (streptococci,
Peptostreptococcus, Finegoldia, Bacteriodes and other oral anaerobes) is
required.
## Consult Dental Service
## Preferred:
[Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h for 5 days ($) [R]](psjzid-amoxicillin-500mg-po-q8h)
< OR >
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h for 5 days ($) [R]](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)
## Primary alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Cefdinir 300 mg PO q12h ($) [R] for 5 days](psjzid-cefdinir-300mg-po-q12h)

## TOOTH ABSCESS AND OTHER SUPPURATIVE ODONTOGENIC INFECTIONS
## TOOTH ABSCESS AND OTHER SUPPURATIVE ODONTOGENIC INFECTIONS
Surgical drainage, scaling and antimicrobial treatment are essential and tooth
extraction is required in most cases. All patients should be referred to the
dental service for assessment and direction of treatment. Empirical coverage for
likely pathogens (streptococci, Peptostreptococcus, Finegoldia, Bacteriodes and
other oral anaerobes is required. Immunocompromised patients need additional
coverage for Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
## Treatment of mild to moderate disease in immunocompetent patients or step-down
## therapy after initial intravenous therapy. Adjust duration for a total of 7-14
## days of antimicrobial therapy.
Preferred:
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO q12h for 7 to 14 days ($) [R]
Alternative
Clindamycin 450 mg PO q8h for 7 to 14 days ($) [H,O]
## Treatment of severe disease in immunocompetent patients
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3gm IV once STAT ($) [R]
Alternative:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT ($) [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT
($) [DI]
## Treatment in immunocompromised patients
Preferred:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R]
Alternative:
Meropenem 1 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R,O]
